topic: Better, but not well yet: the plant (animated carousel, native style, Blog 2)
caption:
Better, but not well yet?

That in-between stage of burnout recovery is common, and it has a shape. In Swedish research following people treated for burnout, most improved a great deal, though only some felt fully recovered years later. People described setbacks along the way, needing quiet rest early on and shorter, more active breaks later, and a lower tolerance for stress was the thing that most often lingered.

A harder week is part of the road, not the end of it.
